title: Cascaded Context DAE
subtitle: Deployment

overview.title: Artifact in input units
overview.description: Centre selection, optional DC removal and rescaling

nodes.title: Deployment input normalisation
description: Demean across configured axes; optionally divide by input standard deviation.
Packing and context axis come from the run configuration.

nodes.title: Epoch context
description: One EEG channel; epoch and context sizes follow the configuration.

nodes.title: First dense autoencoder
description: Flatten input; Linear / LeakyReLU / Dropout encoder and decoder.
Map the context to the centre artifact.

nodes.title: Subtract first estimate
description: Copy the context and subtract stage 1 only from its centre epoch.

nodes.title: Second dense autoencoder
description: Predict residual artifact from the modified context.

nodes.title: Sum both predictions
description: Artifact = stage 1 + stage 2; output preserves the centre epoch length.

nodes.title: Deployment artifact output
description: Convert the configured core output to a centre artifact.
Optionally remove prediction DC; restore the input scale.

edges.label: Deployment input normalisation to Epoch context
Epoch context to First dense autoencoder
First dense autoencoder to Subtract first estimate
Subtract first estimate to Second dense autoencoder
Second dense autoencoder to Sum both predictions
Sum both predictions to Deployment artifact output

notes: Deployment changes normalisation and objective; architecture parameters remain configuration-dependent.
Dimensions and repeated-block counts are configurable; consult the linked implementation and run configuration.
